signal: Archway Group became independent in 2025 after Aquiline acquired SEI's Family Office Services business, and partnered with Arch to deliver a unified platform for UHNW investors

email.body1:
Michael, saw Archway went independent this year and just partnered with Arch on a unified platform for UHNW investors.

A new chapter like that usually opens more in-market accounts than the team can cover, and that gap is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Archway off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Michael, quick follow-up for Archway.

Going independent usually raises the bar on pipeline faster than headcount can follow. Most teams don't know exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Archway needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Michael, last bit of proof for Archway.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Archway's reply rate likely compares to peers. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Michael, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Standing up an independent business is its own kind of busy, and timing matters more than anything here.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to Archway either way.
